paragraphs.text:
You convince your chosen expedition leader that your mission is 
important. He helps you for the rest of the trip. You may add a 
bonus die when asked to Know (EDU) rolls for the duration of 
the adventure. Note this, then go to 500, or lay low and go to 520.
